explanation: Merged main brings in the contributor credit (CONTRIBUTOR_NAMES in siteInfo.ts, CITATION.cff) and the public-export README overlay. This branch fixes the knip gate: knip.json configures workspaces["."] with src/main.tsx as an entry, ignores vendor/, Rscript and @typescript/typescript6, and excludes the sealed datasetQuality.ts from export findings. The exclusion keeps datasetQuality.ts byte-identical to the sha256 in the pipeline-separation reader review; no evidence record, QC policy or validation status changes.
